THEBRUTE-TOXEMIA.title: Toxemia
THEBRUTE-TOXEMIA.description: The first {Cards:plural:time|{:diff()} times} you lose Max HP each turn, gain Max HP equal to the amount lost.
THEBRUTE-SYMBIOSIS.title: Symbiosis
THEBRUTE-SYMBIOSIS.description: The first [blue]{Cards:plural:time|{:diff()} times}[/blue] you lose Max HP each turn, gain Max HP equal to the amount lost.
THEBRUTE-SYMBIOSIS.flavor: A remnant of self-control... trapped, watching all the while...
THEBRUTE-INFERNAL_PLASMA.title: Infernal Plasma
THEBRUTE-INFERNAL_PLASMA.description: The first time you lose HP during an event, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
THEBRUTE-INFERNAL_PLASMA.flavor: Another poison, another day to live.
THEBRUTE-FESTERING_HUNGER.title: Festering Hunger
THEBRUTE-FESTERING_HUNGER.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Gnaws into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CROOKED_SIGNET.title: Crooked Signet
THEBRUTE-CROOKED_SIGNET.description: While your Gold is at or below [blue]{GoldThreshold}[/blue], you have [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CROOKED_SIGNET.flavor: It will forever be my fault...
THEBRUTE-SIGNED_CONFESSION.title: Signed Confession
THEBRUTE-SIGNED_CONFESSION.description: Marks an additional shop on each path before the Act's [gold]Boss[/gold].
THEBRUTE-SIGNED_CONFESSION.flavor: Merchants of Yonder... Not exactly the brightest. Might as well use it to my advantage.
THEBRUTE-ARCHE_ARMOR.title: Arche Armor
THEBRUTE-ARCHE_ARMOR.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Plating[/gold], gain an additional [blue]{PlatingPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ARCHE_ARMOR.flavor: The Architect... Wearing her face. Defiler.
THEBRUTE-BIOCATALYST.title: Biocatalyst
THEBRUTE-BIOCATALYST.flavor: More nourishment for the parasites... Great.
THEBRUTE-THORNY_HELMET.title: Thorny Helmet
THEBRUTE-THORNY_HELMET.description: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain [blue]{ThornsPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-BLOOD_BANK.title: Blood Bank
THEBRUTE-BLOOD_BANK.description: Every [blue]{MaxHp:diff()}[/blue] times you lose Max HP, draw [blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SEA_GLASS.THEBRUTE-THE_BRUTE.title: Virulent Glass
THEBRUTE-CROWNS_DIAMOND.title: Crown's Diamond
THEBRUTE-CROWNS_DIAMOND.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [gold]Gold[/gold] related {Cards:plural:card|cards} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CROWNS_DIAMOND.flavor: I seem to recognize this object from somewhere... strange.
THEBRUTE-SPINE_CHARM.title: Spine Charm
THEBRUTE-SPINE_CHARM.description: The first {Cards:cond:>1?[blue]{Cards:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] related cards|[gold]Thorns[/gold] related card} you play each combat {Cards:plural:is|are} free to play.
